text.en: PUB, Singapore's National Water Agency, Our Water Story: Local Catchment Water. Rain falling on two-thirds of Singapore's land is channelled to 17 reservoirs; the catchment grew from half to two-thirds of the land with Marina, Punggol and Serangoon Reservoirs; Singapore's land area is about 710 km².
text.zh: 新加坡公用事业局（PUB）《我们的水故事：本地集水》：落在新加坡三分之二土地上的雨水被引进 17 个蓄水池；随着滨海、榜鹅和实龙岗蓄水池建成，集水区从国土的一半扩大到三分之二；新加坡面积约 710 平方公里。

text.en: PUB, Annual Report 2023 (timeline "From the first drop"): MacRitchie Reservoir, completed in 1867, is Singapore's first reservoir and was named in 1922 after Municipal Engineer James MacRitchie, who designed and built it; the Kranji–Pandan Water Scheme was completed in 1975; Linggiu Reservoir was completed in 1993; Punggol and Serangoon Reservoirs were commissioned in 2011; six water treatment plants serve Singapore today.
text.zh: PUB《2023 年年报》（时间线“从第一滴水开始”）：麦里芝蓄水池于 1867 年建成，是新加坡第一个蓄水池，1922 年以设计和兴建它的市政工程师麦里芝命名；克兰芝—班丹水源计划 1975 年完成；林木水库 1993 年建成；榜鹅和实龙岗蓄水池 2011 年启用；今天有 6 座水厂为新加坡供水。

text.en: PUB, Annual Report 2013: Singapore is a small island that lacks large freshwater bodies such as big rivers and lakes; it receives some 2,400 mm of rain a year but has limited land to collect and store it; its first three reservoirs lie in protected catchments within the Central Nature Reserve; Upper Peirce Reservoir, Singapore's largest, created in 1975; the Seletar Reservoir enlarged in 1969; the Sungei Seletar–Bedok Water Scheme completed in 1986; by the 1980s estuarine reservoirs such as Kranji, Sarimbun, Murai, Poyan and Tengeh; the 1961 agreement allowed water from the Gunong Pulai catchment, the Tebrau and the Scudai for 50 years, the 1962 agreement up to 250 mgd from the Johor River for 99 years.
text.zh: PUB《2013 年年报》：新加坡是一座小岛，没有大河大湖这样的大片淡水；一年雨量约 2400 毫米，却没有多少土地可用来收集和储存雨水；最早的三个蓄水池位于中央自然保护区内的受保护集水区；1975 年建成当时最大的贝雅士蓄水池上段；1969 年扩建实里达蓄水池；1986 年完成实里达河—勿洛水源计划；到 1980 年代已有克兰芝、莎琳汶、慕莱、波扬、登格等河口蓄水池；1961 年协议允许取用布莱山集水区、地不佬河与士姑来河的水 50 年，1962 年协议允许从柔佛河每日取水至多 250 百万加仑、为期 99 年。

text.en: PUB, Development of local catchments: the first three reservoirs, MacRitchie, Peirce and Seletar, lie in protected catchments where major development is not allowed; a Water Planning Unit was set up under the Prime Minister's Office in 1971 and the Water Master Plan drawn up in 1972 as the long-term blueprint, covering unprotected catchments, water reuse and desalination; in unprotected catchments only homes and non-polluting industries are allowed, with stringent pollution control, and better treatment makes their water usable; Pandan, Bedok, Lower Seletar, Marina, Punggol and Serangoon have unprotected catchments.
text.zh: PUB《本地集水区的发展》：最早的三个蓄水池麦里芝、贝雅士和实里达位于不允许大型开发的受保护集水区；1971 年总理公署设立水务规划组，1972 年制定水务总蓝图作为长远发展的依据，涵盖非保护集水区、循环用水和海水淡化；非保护集水区只允许住宅和无污染工业，并须严格管制污染，水处理技术的进步让这些水可以使用；班丹、勿洛、实里达下段、滨海、榜鹅和实龙岗的集水区都属于非保护集水区。

text.en: PUB, Self-guided ABC Waters learning trail, Lower Seletar Reservoir (guide for students), "A Blast to the Past": 1920, a third reservoir after MacRitchie and Peirce, Seletar Reservoir; expanded in 1940 and 1967; 1986, a dam across the mouth of the Seletar River forms Sungei Seletar Reservoir; 1992, the two are renamed Upper and Lower Seletar Reservoir.
text.zh: PUB《活跃、美丽、洁净水域自学步道：实里达蓄水池下段（学生版）》“回到过去”：1920 年，继麦里芝和贝雅士之后建成第三个蓄水池——实里达蓄水池；1940 年和 1967 年两次扩建；1986 年在实里达河口筑坝，形成实里达河蓄水池；1992 年两者分别改名为实里达蓄水池上段和下段。

text.en: PUB, Geographical investigation field study: Upper Peirce Reservoir. A higher dam was built upstream of the Peirce Reservoir dam in 1970; Upper Peirce Reservoir was completed in 1975 and opened on 27 February 1977.
text.zh: PUB《地理考察：贝雅士蓄水池上段》：1970 年在贝雅士蓄水池原有水坝的上游筑起一道更高的坝；贝雅士蓄水池上段 1975 年建成，1977 年 2 月 27 日开幕。

text.en: PUB, Bedok Reservoir: a former sand quarry, turned into a reservoir from 1983 under the Sungei Seletar–Bedok Water Scheme and completed in 1986.
text.zh: PUB《勿洛蓄水池》：原是采沙场，1983 年起按实里达河—勿洛水源计划改建为蓄水池，1986 年建成。

text.en: National Heritage Board, Roots.sg, Lower Peirce Reservoir (historic site): Singapore's second impounding reservoir, first called Kallang River Reservoir, renamed Peirce Reservoir in 1922 and Lower Peirce Reservoir in 1975.
text.zh: 国家文物局 Roots.sg《贝雅士蓄水池下段》（历史地点）：新加坡第二个蓄水池，原名加冷河蓄水池，1922 年改名贝雅士蓄水池，1975 年再改名贝雅士蓄水池下段。

text.en: National Heritage Board, Roots.sg, Jurong Heritage Trail: Pandan Reservoir, formed in 1974 by enclosing the swamps of the Sungei Pandan estuary with an earthen dyke.
text.zh: 国家文物局 Roots.sg《裕廊文物径：班丹蓄水池》：1974 年用土堤围住班丹河口的沼泽，形成班丹蓄水池。

text.en: National Heritage Board, Roots.sg, Jurong Heritage Trail: around the Jurong River. Jurong Lake was formed when the upper section of the Jurong River was dammed in 1971.
text.zh: 国家文物局 Roots.sg《裕廊文物径：裕廊河一带》：1971 年在裕廊河上游筑坝，形成裕廊湖。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), Challenge accepted: Singapore's water catchment areas. From 1975 to 1981 the Kranji, Pandan, Murai, Poyan, Sarimbun and Tengeh rivers were dammed to create new reservoirs.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《迎接挑战：新加坡的集水区》：1975 年至 1981 年间，克兰芝、班丹、慕莱、波扬、莎琳汶和登格几条河先后筑坝，形成新的蓄水池。

text.en: PUB, Marina Barrage: built across the mouth of the Marina Channel, it creates Singapore's 15th reservoir, the first in the heart of the city; officially opened on 31 October 2008; Marina Reservoir was commissioned as a freshwater reservoir on 20 November 2010; its catchment is 10,000 hectares, the island's largest and most urbanised.
text.zh: PUB《滨海堤坝》：横跨滨海水道出海口，形成新加坡第 15 个蓄水池，也是第一个位于市中心的蓄水池；2008 年 10 月 31 日正式启用；2010 年 11 月 20 日滨海蓄水池作为淡水蓄水池启用；集水区 1 万公顷，是全岛最大、城市化程度最高的集水区。

text.en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Singapore, Water Agreements: the 1961 agreement let Singapore draw raw water from the Tebrau and Scudai rivers, with treated water to Johor of 12 % of what was imported, and expired on 31 August 2011, when the Gunong Pulai and Scudai waterworks and the Pontian and Tebrau pump houses were handed to the Johor State government; the 1962 agreement entitles Singapore to draw 250 million gallons of raw water a day from the Johor River until 2061, with treated water to Johor up to 2 % (or 5 mgd) of the water supplied to Singapore; in 1990 PUB and the Johor State government signed an agreement to build Linggiu Reservoir; PUB treats the water at the Johor River Waterworks near Kota Tinggi; the Johor River Barrage has operated since August 2016.
text.zh: 新加坡外交部《水供协议》：1961 年协议让新加坡从地不佬河与士姑来河取原水，并按进口量的 12% 向柔佛供应处理过的水，于 2011 年 8 月 31 日到期，届时新加坡把布莱山与士姑来水厂以及笨珍、地不佬的抽水站交给柔佛州政府；1962 年协议让新加坡每日从柔佛河取原水 250 百万加仑，直到 2061 年，并向柔佛供应至多相当于新加坡供水量 2%（即 5 百万加仑）的处理过的水；1990 年 PUB 与柔佛州政府签约兴建林木水库；PUB 在哥打丁宜附近的柔佛河水厂处理河水；柔佛河拦河坝自 2016 年 8 月运作。

text.en: PUB, Our Water Story: Imported Water. Under the 1962 Water Agreement Singapore can draw up to 250 million gallons of water a day from the Johor River until 2061 and provides Johor with treated water up to 2 % of the water imported; Linggiu Reservoir was built by PUB under a 1990 agreement with Johor supplementary to the 1962 agreement; the Johor River Waterworks is owned and operated by PUB.
text.zh: PUB《我们的水故事：进口水》：按照 1962 年水供协议，新加坡每日可从柔佛河取水至多 250 百万加仑，直到 2061 年，并须向柔佛供应至多相当于进口量 2% 的处理过的水；林木水库是 PUB 按 1990 年与柔佛签订、作为 1962 年协议补充的协议兴建的；柔佛河水厂由 PUB 拥有和运作。

text.en: Agreement relating to the separation of Singapore from Malaysia as an independent and sovereign State, 7 August 1965, Article 14 (United Nations Treaty Series vol. 563, no. 8206): the Government of Singapore guarantees that PUB, and the Government of Malaysia that the Government of the State of Johore, will abide by the Water Agreements dated 1 September 1961 and 29 September 1962.
text.zh: 1965 年 8 月 7 日《关于新加坡脱离马来西亚成为独立主权国家的协议》第 14 条（《联合国条约汇编》第 563 卷第 8206 号）：新加坡政府保证 PUB、马来西亚政府保证柔佛州政府，遵守 1961 年 9 月 1 日和 1962 年 9 月 29 日的两份水供协议。

text.en: Ministry of Water, Land and Natural Resources (KATS), Malaysia, written answer to the Dewan Rakyat, 12 November 2019 (Malay): the 1962 agreement was made on 29 September 1962 for 99 years; Clause 5 lets Singapore use water from the Johor River up to 250 million gallons a day (1,094 million litres); Malaysia may buy 5 million gallons a day of treated water (Clause 11, not exceeding 2 % of the water supplied to Singapore); free raw water was supplied to Singapore from 1927 to 1961.
text.zh: 马来西亚水务、土地与天然资源部（KATS）2019 年 11 月 12 日给下议院的书面答复（马来文）：1962 年协议签于 1962 年 9 月 29 日，为期 99 年；第 5 条允许新加坡从柔佛河用水每日至多 250 百万加仑（1094 百万公升）；马来西亚可购买每日 5 百万加仑处理过的水（第 11 条，不超过供应新加坡总量的 2%）；1927 年至 1961 年新加坡获得免费原水。

note.en: The ministry converts 250 mgd to 1,094 million litres a day; a Johor State answer (S17) gives 1,136.52 million litres for the supply after 2061. One imperial gallon is about 4.546 litres.
note.zh: 该部把 250 百万加仑换算为每日 1094 百万公升；柔佛州的答复（S17）对 2061 年后的供水写作 1136.52 百万公升。1 英制加仑约 4.546 公升。

text.en: Dewan Negeri Johor (Johor State Legislative Assembly), written answers of 3 December 2023 (Malay): the 1962 agreement was signed on 29 September 1962 for 99 years, and Singapore is to hand over the Johor River Water Works at Kota Tinggi and the Linggiu Dam to the Johor government on 30 September 2061.
text.zh: 柔佛州议会 2023 年 12 月 3 日书面答复（马来文）：1962 年协议签于 1962 年 9 月 29 日，为期 99 年；新加坡须在 2061 年 9 月 30 日把哥打丁宜的柔佛河水厂和林木水坝交给柔佛州政府。

text.en: BERNAMA (Malaysian National News Agency), 12 March 2019 (Malay): the agreement that ends in 2061 entitles Singapore to up to 250 million gallons a day of raw water from the Johor River; this does not include the free raw water supplied to Singapore from 1927 to 1961.
text.zh: 马来西亚国家新闻社（BERNAMA）2019 年 3 月 12 日（马来文）：这份 2061 年到期的协议让新加坡每日从柔佛河取原水至多 250 百万加仑；此外，1927 年至 1961 年新加坡获得的是免费原水。

text.en: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Arts, Singapore, Water Talks? If Only It Could Be Simple (2003): under the 1927 water agreement Singapore obtained water free from Johor and paid rent for the land of the catchment and waterworks.
text.zh: 新加坡新闻、通讯及艺术部《水供谈判？但愿能那么简单》（2003）：按照 1927 年的水供协议，新加坡从柔佛免费取水，只须为集水区和水厂的土地付租金。

note.en: Singapore's sources mention the land rent; the Malaysian sources (S16, S18) describe the water of 1927–1961 as free raw water. Both are given.
note.zh: 新加坡方面的来源提到地租；马来西亚方面的来源（S16、S18）把 1927 年至 1961 年的水称为免费原水。两种说法并列。

text.en: Berita RTM (Radio Televisyen Malaysia), 13 October 2026 (Malay): the Linggiu Dam is managed and operated by PUB, in line with the 1962 Johor River Water Agreement and a supplementary agreement of 1990.
text.zh: 马来西亚广播电视台新闻（Berita RTM）2026 年 10 月 13 日（马来文）：林木水坝由 PUB 管理和运作，依据的是 1962 年柔佛河水供协议和 1990 年的补充协议。

text.en: PUB, Our Water Story: NEWater. NEWater was launched to the public on 9 August 2002, when 60,000 people at the National Day Parade toasted with it; it is made in three stages: microfiltration or ultrafiltration, reverse osmosis and ultraviolet disinfection; there are currently 4 NEWater plants in operation; the Bedok NEWater Factory closed on 31 July 2024.
text.zh: PUB《我们的水故事：新生水》：2002 年 8 月 9 日国庆庆典上，6 万人举起新生水为国家庆生，新生水正式面向公众；制作分三步：微滤或超滤、反渗透、紫外线消毒；目前有 4 座新生水厂在运作；勿洛新生水厂于 2024 年 7 月 31 日关闭。

text.en: PUB, media release annex of 24 June 2024 (NEWater Visitor Centre to close): Bedok and Kranji NEWater Factories officially opened in January 2003; Seletar in June 2004 (closed in 2011); Ulu Pandan in March 2007; Changi NEWater Factory 1 in May 2010 and Factory 2 in January 2017.
text.zh: PUB 2024 年 6 月 24 日新闻稿附件（新生水访客中心将关闭）：勿洛和克兰芝新生水厂 2003 年 1 月正式启用；实里达新生水厂 2004 年 6 月启用（2011 年关闭）；乌鲁班丹 2007 年 3 月；樟宜第一新生水厂 2010 年 5 月，第二厂 2017 年 1 月。

text.en: PUB, Our Water Story: Desalinated Water. There are currently 5 desalination plants in Singapore: SingSpring (September 2005, the first, which established the fourth National Tap), Tuas South (formerly Tuaspring, 2013, the largest), Tuas (2018), Keppel Marina East (2020, the first dual-mode plant, treating seawater or water from Marina Reservoir) and Jurong Island (April 2022); they use reverse osmosis.
text.zh: PUB《我们的水故事：淡化海水》：新加坡目前有 5 座海水淡化厂：新泉（2005 年 9 月，第一座，第四个国家水喉由此建立）、大士南（原大士泉，2013 年，规模最大）、大士（2018 年）、吉宝滨海东（2020 年，第一座双模式淡化厂，可处理海水或滨海蓄水池的水）和裕廊岛（2022 年 4 月）；都采用反渗透。

text.en: PUB, The Singapore Water Loop: water demand is about 440 million gallons a day, enough to fill 800 Olympic-sized swimming pools, and could almost double by 2065, when NEWater and desalination will meet the majority of demand.
text.zh: PUB《新加坡水循环》：目前用水量约每日 440 百万加仑，足以注满 800 个奥运标准游泳池；到 2065 年可能接近翻倍，届时新生水和淡化海水将满足大部分用水需求。

text.en: PUB, Our Water Story exhibition panels (SG60, 2025): the Four National Taps; there are currently 17 reservoirs; more than two-thirds of the land are water catchment zones; Singapore has four NEWater factories, two in Changi and one each in Ulu Pandan and Kranji; 5 desalination plants; treatment at 6 PUB waterworks and 4 water reclamation plants.
text.zh: PUB《我们的水故事》展板（SG60，2025）：四大水喉；目前有 17 个蓄水池；超过三分之二的土地是集水区；4 座新生水厂，樟宜 2 座，乌鲁班丹和克兰芝各 1 座；5 座海水淡化厂；6 座 PUB 水厂和 4 座再生水厂。

text.en: National Library Board, BiblioAsia vol. 20 no. 2 (July–September 2024), "The Singapore–Johor Causeway": first opened to goods trains on 17 September 1923, officially opened on 28 June 1924; a tunnel was built below the lock so that water pipes could be run to Singapore.
text.zh: 国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》第 20 卷第 2 期（2024 年 7–9 月）《新柔长堤》：1923 年 9 月 17 日先通货运火车，1924 年 6 月 28 日正式启用；船闸下修了一条隧道，让水管通到新加坡。

text.en: National Heritage Board, Roots.sg collection record of the Johor–Singapore Causeway: completed in 1923 and officially opened in June 1924, 1,056 metres long; in 1932 pipelines were added to the causeway to carry water between Johor and Singapore.
text.zh: 国家文物局 Roots.sg 新柔长堤藏品记录：1923 年建成，1924 年 6 月正式启用，长 1056 米；1932 年在长堤上加装水管，在柔佛与新加坡之间输水。

text.en: Promote Mandarin Council, Singaporean Mandarin Database, entries 蓄水池 (reservoir), 四大水喉 (Four National Taps) and 新生水 (NEWater): Singapore's standard Chinese terms, including 麦里芝蓄水池 and 登格蓄水池.
text.zh: 讲华语运动理事会《新加坡华语资料库》“蓄水池”“四大水喉”“新生水”条目：新加坡的规范华文用语，包括“麦里芝蓄水池”“登格蓄水池”。

text.en: Contains information from Master Plan 2019 Land Use layer accessed on 14 October 2026 from data.gov.sg (Urban Redevelopment Authority) which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence). Used for the reservoir water surfaces on the map.
text.zh: 含有 2026 年 10 月 14 日取自 data.gov.sg（市区重建局）的“2019 年总体规划土地用途图层”资料，该资料依《新加坡开放数据许可》1.0 版（https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence）提供。用于地图上的蓄水池水面。

text.en: Contains information from Master Plan 2019 Planning Area Boundary (No Sea) accessed on 14 October 2026 from data.gov.sg (Urban Redevelopment Authority) which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence). Used for the coastline of Singapore on the map.
text.zh: 含有 2026 年 10 月 14 日取自 data.gov.sg（市区重建局）的“2019 年总体规划规划区边界（不含海域）”资料，该资料依《新加坡开放数据许可》1.0 版提供。用于地图上的新加坡海岸线。

text.en: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Open Database License 1.0 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright): reservoir names and outlines, Linggiu Reservoir, the Johor River pipeline route and the positions of plants, exported on 14 October 2026. The map data derived from it is offered under the same licence.
text.zh: © OpenStreetMap 贡献者，开放数据库许可 1.0（https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright）：蓄水池名称与轮廓、林木水库、柔佛河输水管走向和各厂位置，2026 年 10 月 14 日导出。由此衍生的地图数据按同一许可提供。

text.en: PUB, Water treatment: raw water is treated at the waterworks, for example at Choa Chu Kang, Chestnut Avenue, Woodleigh, Lower Seletar and Bedok, before it goes into the supply network.
text.zh: PUB《水处理》：原水在水厂处理后才进入供水管网，例如蔡厝港、策士纳道、活林、实里达下段和勿洛水厂。

text.en: PUB, Deep Tunnel Sewerage System (DTSS): Phase 1, completed in 2008, is a 48 km deep sewer tunnel from Kranji to Changi with 60 km of link sewers and Changi Water Reclamation Plant; the whole DTSS will be a 206 km network of deep tunnels carrying used water by gravity to three centralised water reclamation plants.
text.zh: PUB《深隧道排污系统》：第一期 2008 年完成，包括从克兰芝到樟宜、长 48 公里的深层污水隧道，60 公里的连接污水管和樟宜再生水厂；整个系统将是一个 206 公里长的深隧道网络，靠重力把用过的水送到三座集中的再生水厂。
